description: Read-only, tie-safe access to the append-only managed_dispatch_event audit trail. Optional dispatch_id, event_kind, and accepted filters narrow the page. Rows are ordered by event_at then id. A non-null next_cursor means another page exists; callers echo both after_event_at and after_id until next_cursor is null before claiming complete event coverage.
embedding_description: Enumerate accepted and rejected managed-dispatch event evidence through StateManagementInterface with a stable event_at/id cursor. Use this bounded read for complete audit, migration, causal-race review, and verification of evidence-bound legacy corrections without raw SQL or truncation guesses.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: A bounded events page with returned, truncated, and next_cursor fields.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State the filters, returned count, and whether next_cursor is null. Distinguish accepted events from rejected audit rows and never call a truncated page complete.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads managed_dispatch_event through StateManagementInterface.query_ordered using the composite event_at/id cursor; the event log remains append-only.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: page_limit_invalid means limit is outside 1..250. page_cursor_invalid means only one cursor component was supplied. accepted_filter_invalid means accepted was not boolean.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use valid filters and echo both cursor components exactly. Continue paging until next_cursor is null before computing totals or digests.
